originalAlarm.description: accessing `ch` that was invalidated by call to `free()` during the call to `delete_eth_table()` on line 44.

reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE (KNOWN, CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED): Same file and bug as PRODUCT_40 (bc0ffc0e971.c). The known vbdb bug is UseAfterFree when ENABLE_FEATURE_CLEAN_UP=true: in delete_eth_table(), 'ch' is freed at line 44, but ch->next is accessed at line 43 (loop increment after free). The presence condition (CLEAN_UP=true) is exactly correct — the free() call only occurs inside the #ifdef ENABLE_FEATURE_CLEAN_UP block. The alarm correctly identifies this real bug.
